description: Roll expected receipts and payments into a 13-week cash forecast. Send the start date (week 1 starts that day), the opening cash balance, an optional minimum balance, and the items (date, receipt or payment, amount), each one-off or repeating weekly, every 2 weeks or monthly. Get back each of the 13 weeks with its dates, opening balance, receipts, payments, net and closing balance, the totals, the lowest week-end balance and its week, the weeks below your minimum, and the items that fall outside the 13 weeks. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/cash-forecast-13-week). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

amount.description: Amount (above 0; direction says in or out).

date.description: Date the cash comes in or goes out, YYYY-MM-DD (for a repeating item: the first date of the pattern; dates before start_date are skipped).

repeat.description: Optional: none (default), weekly, every_2_weeks or monthly (same day each month; the last day in shorter months).

until.description: Optional, with repeat: last date the item may fall on (inclusive).

what.description: Optional label, e.g. 'payroll' or 'rent' (your own text, echoed).

label.description: Optional label for the forecast (your own text, echoed).

minimum_balance.description: Optional: the lowest balance you accept (default 0).

opening_balance.description: Cash balance at the start of week 1 (may be negative).

start_date.description: First day of week 1, YYYY-MM-DD (often a Monday). Week k covers start_date + 7(k-1) to start_date + 7k - 1.

name: cash_forecast_13_week
title: 13-Week Cash Forecast
